> Caligrafy Quill 2.25.0. Generated from the source by `php qa/build-api-reference.php`; the guides explain how to use these classes, this reference says exactly what each public method takes and returns. Back to the [API reference](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/API-Reference).

Source: [framework/core/Notify.php:28](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Notify.php#L28)

Class Notify
Notify::user($userId, ['title' =&gt; ..., 'body' =&gt; ..., 'url' =&gt; ..., 'tag' =&gt; ..., 'urgency' =&gt; ...]) sends to every
channel the user turned on and logs the result (caligrafy_notifications: never the body; kept 30 days):

- push: each browser the user subscribed (caligrafy_push_subscriptions), with the VAPID keys of .env (php caligrafer.php notify keys), 5 seconds per push service, the message kept 24 hours for a device that is off; a 404 or 410 deletes the subscription, so do 5 failures in a row
- email: the user's confirmed address only (caligrafy_notify_emails), through MAIL_*, with a one-click unsubscribe link (a signed URL) and the List-Unsubscribe headers

A delivery failure never throws; a bad message throws ServiceError::invalid. At most NOTIFY_RATE_PER_HOUR messages per
user and hour (30): above it nothing is sent ('skipped' =&gt; 'rate'). In-page alerts stay the app's job.
Without the tables (php caligrafer.php platform install) nothing is sent and nothing fails.

## Constants

+ `CHANNELS = array('push', 'email')`
+ `SUBSCRIPTIONS = 'caligrafy_push_subscriptions'`
+ `EMAILS = 'caligrafy_notify_emails'`
+ `PREFS = 'caligrafy_notify_prefs'`
+ `LOG = 'caligrafy_notifications'`
+ `TTL = 86400`
+ `PUSH_TIMEOUT = 5`
+ `MAX_FAILURES = 5`
+ `PAYLOAD_BYTES = 3072`
+ `TOKEN_HOURS = 24`
+ `KEEP_DAYS = 30`

## Public properties

+ `public static $pushSender = null`: callable|null replaces the push sender in tests: fn(array $subscriptions, string $payload, array $options) =&gt; [endpoint =&gt; status]
+ `public static $mailSender = null`: callable|null replaces the mail sender in tests: fn($to, $subject, $html, array $headers) =&gt; bool

<a name="notify-user"></a>
### `Notify::user()`

```php
public static function user($userId, array $message)
```

Sends a message to a user on every channel they turned on

**Parameters**

+ `$userId` `int|string`: the id Context::userId() returns
+ `$message` `array`: title (80), body (300), url (https or a path of the app), tag, urgency (low, normal, high)

**Returns** `array`: push (how many browsers got it), email (whether it was sent), skipped (null, or 'rate')

+ **@throws** ServiceError invalid, on a bad message

Source: [framework/core/Notify.php:58](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Notify.php#L58)
